data.desc: Scinai Immunotherapeutics Ltd. (Nasdaq: SCNI) is a biopharmaceutical company operating a growing contract development and manufacturing organization alongside an immunology-focused therapeutic development platform. Through its wholly owned subsidiary, Scinai Biopharma Services Ltd., the Company provides development and manufacturing services to biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies at its facilities in Jerusalem and Yavne, Israel. Scinai also advances its NanoAb platform through research collaboration and license arrangements with the Max Planck Society and University Medical Center Göttingen, both in Germany.
